habits.title: Dead hang (rings or bar)
habits.prompt: 3 sets of dead hangs, 20–40s each on rings (prefer) or a bar. False grip optional on rings. Rest as needed. Stop if elbows hurt.
habits.notePrompt: Equipment used, longest hang (seconds), how grips felt

habits.title: Scapular pulls
habits.prompt: 3×8 scapular pull-ups from a dead hang on rings or bar: shrug shoulders down/back without bending elbows.

habits.title: Negative pull-ups
habits.prompt: 3×3–5 slow negatives (3–5s lower) on rings or bar. Jump/step to the top; lower with control. Rings: keep rings close to the body.
habits.notePrompt: Equipment, slowest rep time, sticking point

habits.title: Hang maintain
habits.prompt: 2×30–45s dead hang on rings or bar after negatives.

habits.title: Assisted ring / bar pull-ups
habits.prompt: 4×3–6 assisted pull-ups. Prefer gymnast rings with feet or toes on the floor (lighten help over the weeks). Bar + band is fine if no rings. Use the least assistance that keeps form clean.
habits.notePrompt: Rings or bar, assistance used, total clean reps

habits.title: Ring rows finisher
habits.prompt: 3×8–12 ring rows (body more horizontal = harder). Full scapular squeeze at the top. Skip only if no rings — then do 2×3 slow bar negatives instead.
habits.notePrompt: Body angle and how many clean reps

habits.title: Pull-up attempts
habits.prompt: Warm up, then attempt 1–3 unassisted pull-ups on a bar (goal equipment). Film one attempt. If none yet: 3 assisted (feet on rings, or bar + band) + 3 negatives.
habits.notePrompt: Did chin clear the bar? What limited you?
